info.name: TrueLern Mobile API
info.description: Production-ready API collection for TrueLern Mobile Applications (Student, Parent, Faculty, Admin). Sourced directly from live LMSCA/TrueLern backend routes.

item.name: 01 - Public
item.description: Publicly accessible endpoints for marketing, catalog, and lead registration.

item.name: 02 - Authentication
item.description: User authentication, mobile Google OAuth exchange, token refresh, logout, password lifecycle, and single-use handoff.

request.description: Exchanges a verified Google ID Token from Credential Manager for a TrueLern mobile Parent application session.
Refreshes short-lived TrueLern access token with refresh token rotation and replay prevention.
Revokes active mobile application session and invalidates refreshToken in the database.
Retrieves authenticated Parent profile, user role, and linked children array via Bearer token.
Authenticates student account. Automatically extracts and stores accessToken into environment.
Authenticates parent account with multi-ward linked access.
Authenticates faculty/teacher account for live class instruction and grading.
Authenticates administrator account for mobile supervisor capabilities.
Silent rotation of JWT accessToken using stored refreshToken.
Validates short-lived checkout handoff token after public enrollment.
Changes current user password and invalidates active refresh tokens.
Generates password reset token and dispatches reset notification.
Invalidates server-side session and clears refreshToken.

item.description: Parent portal endpoints with strict ParentStudentLink authorization.

Upcoming and past live classroom schedules for selected ward.
Recorded classroom sessions available for review and study.

Notifications directed to the parent concerning attendance alerts, fee reminders, and class schedules.

item.name: 05 - Faculty
item.description: Teacher endpoints for instruction, batch tracking, and availability.

request.description: List of faculty members and subject assignments.
Faculty profile information, bio, and assigned courses.
Weekly availability schedule and max teaching hours.

item.name: 06 - Courses
item.description: Course catalog, curriculum modules, and syllabus.

request.description: Paginated list of active courses.
Course overview, learning outcomes, pricing, and prerequisites.
Structured curriculum breakdown into modules, topics, and lessons.

item.name: 07 - Enrollments
item.description: Student course enrollments and cohort batch assignments.

request.description: Active enrollment records.
Cohort batches with capacity and teacher assignment.
Batch schedule, roster count, assigned instructor, and course.

item.name: 08 - Live Classes
item.description: Live classroom sessions, scheduling, and secure Jitsi room token generation.

request.description: Live class sessions filtered by batch, teacher, or date.
Class title, scheduled start/end, duration, teacher, and status.

item.name: Generate Live Classroom Jitsi Token (HIGH PRIORITY)

request.description: Generates secure JWT room token for Jitsi Meet integration. Grants moderator permissions to Teachers/Admins, and attendee permissions to enrolled Students.
Announcements posted by faculty for a specific live session.
Slide decks, reference PDFs, and downloadable materials attached to the class.

item.name: 09 - Recordings & Revision
item.description: Classroom lecture recordings with HTTP Range partial content video streaming.

request.description: Streams video recording with HTTP 206 Partial Content support for mobile video players (ExoPlayer / AVPlayer).
List of recordings associated with a completed live class session.

item.name: 10 - Attendance
item.description: Student and cohort attendance logs and session management.

request.description: Paginated attendance history.
Calculated summary with total sessions, present, absent, late counts, and percentage.
Marks individual student attendance record.

item.name: 11 - Assignments
item.description: Homework assignments, file submissions, evaluations, and grading.

request.description: List of published assignments.
Assignment instructions, due date, total marks, and attachments.
Submits student assignment text and file attachment URLs.
Grades student submission with marks and feedback.

item.name: 12 - Assessments
item.description: Quizzes, tests, attempts, and result grading.

request.description: List of active quizzes and exams.
Assessment title, duration minutes, total marks, and passing threshold.
Initiates a timed assessment attempt session.
Submits completed answers for grading.

item.name: 13 - Finance
item.description: Invoices, payment receipts, fee plans, and balance calculations (Stripe remains deferred).

request.description: List of tuition invoices and billing statements.
Invoice breakdown, total amount, amount paid, and balance due.
Transaction history and payment confirmation references.
Downloadable payment receipt records.

item.name: 14 - Notifications
item.description: In-app notifications inbox, read/unread states, and user alert preferences.

request.description: User notification feed with unread indicators.
Updates notification status to read.
Archives notification from active inbox.
User channel preferences for email, SMS, and in-app alerts.

item.name: 15 - Calendar
item.description: Calendar feed and ICS export for synchronizing schedules to iOS/Android device calendars.

request.description: Generates iCalendar standard (.ics) stream for live classes and assignment due dates.

item.description: Course completion certificates, verification, and credentials.

request.description: Earned certificates of completion.
